issue.title: Retire artifacts_files_pane
issue.description: Show the Artifacts ▸ Files sub-tab, a beta pane hidden by default while it is redesigned.

task_type_fields.remove_when: A redesigned Files pane is ready to ship visible by default; delete the hidden-pane branch then. If the redesign replaces or drops the pane instead, delete this flag together with the old pane.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The Artifacts strip omits Files and numbers its panes positionally; file: link follows, the show-Files action, and sase artifact pane show files explain that Files is a disabled beta pane instead of opening it.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: sase's TUI shows the Artifacts ▸ Files sub-tab as the last pane with the highest digit, and file: link follows land on it.
